edges.citation: Zhou et al. 2015, eLife 4:e08477: second-order aPN1 -> third-order vPN1 (male-specific, fru+); aPN1-vPN1 synaptic connection confirmed by GRASP. VFB lists AMMC-B1 as aPN1a,b — same FBbt ID, same population.
edges.note: Hypothesized: AMMC-B1/aPN1 drives vPN1. Retry sweep 2026-10-15: named limit=50 returns 50 rows with no vPN1; named limit=200 dies server-side (IncompleteRead, broad-class truncation); per-pair probe 0 connections. Still no API rows — hypothesis stands.

edges.citation: Zhou et al. 2015, eLife 4:e08477: vPN1 axons overlap dsx+ pC1 arbors in the LPC region; vPN1 activation drives pC1 calcium responses and both manipulations induce/block song-evoked male chaining. Caveat (authors'): GRASP signal barely detectable — monosynapticity NOT proven.
edges.note: Hypothesized: vPN1 drives pC1. No API rows exist (vPN1->pC1 per-pair probe: 0; vPN1 upstream/downstream: 0). Retry sweep 2026-10-15: vPN1 downstream 0 rows in all three forms; per-pair vPN1->pC1 probe 0 connections. Still no API rows — hypothesis stands.
